description: Stage files in the local workspace for attachment operations. List, read, write, delete files, or create directories. Supports nested paths (e.g. "projects/images/photo.png"). Downloaded attachments land here; upload can read from here. All responses include the absolute filesystem path.

destination.description: Destination path for move operation — works like unix mv: rename a file (move filename:"old.txt" destination:"new.txt"), relocate it (move filename:"file.txt" destination:"subdir/file.txt"), or both at once

filename.description: File or directory path, supports nesting with / separators (required for read, write, delete, mkdir, move)

name: manage_workspace
